entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup` should be able to recover when a release does not have archives #54627
  • Default StaticWebAssetSpaFallbackEnabled to true in Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly #54624
  • dotnet-test mtp should support MSBuild's artifacts output mode #54612

Closed

  • `dotnetup` should acquire non-latest runtimes in `sdk` to fix `GivenThatAPublishedDepsJsonShouldContainVersionInformation` #54608
  • dotnetup: Improve walkthrough subtitle text #53842
  • Dotnetup: Skip signature validation for daily builds, but display warning #54278
  • Support PowerShell profile modification on Windows for both Windows PowerShell and pwsh #53962
  • Verify Signatures of Downloaded Content in DNUP #51093
  • Use `dotnetup` to install preview SDK and runtime in build scripts #52699
  • Support `--use-current-runtime` on `dotnet test` commands #50369
  • Improve dotnet test (MTP) parsing #51990
  • Unable to build the .NET MAUI Preview 9 project, VS IDE reports missing components, maui-check tool unable to find the package as it still points to RC 1 source feed #22009
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Summarize `dotnetup` init decisions to simplify UX #54626
  • Default Blazor WebAssembly SPA fallback endpoint generation to enabled #54625
  • Prevent corrupted user-level NuGet.Config from failing tests #54623
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix `dotnet sln` failing to parse `.slnf` files with unescaped backslashes in path #54622
  • Migrate CollectStaticWebAssetsToCopy to IMultiThreadableTask #54621
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Migrate EncodeRazorInputItem to multi-threadable #54620
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Migrate CheckForUnsupportedWinMDReferences to IMultiThreadableTask #54618
  • Migrate StaticWebAssetsGeneratePackagePropsFile to IMultiThreadableTask #54617
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Validate Microsoft.Testing.Platform ExecutionMode handshake property #54616
    Area-CLI
  • [dotnet test] Two-stage Ctrl+C cancellation for MTP path #54615
  • Containers.targets: (cont) support multi-arch publishing with podman. #54614
    Area-Containers
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54610

Merged

  • Discover installed 8.0.x runtime in DepsJson version test #54619
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Move macOS x64 TestBuild PR leg to CI-only, switch to ARM64 #54604
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix tests which changed CWD without resetting #54599
  • Add 'Investigating PRs and CI failures' guidance to copilot-instructions #54609
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix --environment variables not applied to test process without launch profile #54613
  • Add --use-current-runtime / --ucr support to dotnet test (MTP) #54495
    Area-CLI

Updated

  • Migrate templating search cache publishing to ESRP #54532
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Use suppressors when applying code fixes #54595
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • Add `dotnet test --list-devices` support for MAUI #54565
    Area-CLI
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #54605
  • Remove redundant -restore from Queue Tests pipeline step #54590
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to XUnit/Helix #54231
  • Integrate Helix Job Monitor into CI and PR pipelines #54583
    Area-Infrastructure
  • fix: normalize IntermediateOutputPath slashes in posix platforms #54536
  • Only download runtimes for referenced frameworks #53518
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Add dotnet sdk add and dotnet sdk remove commands #54577
    Area-CLI
  • Restructure CI/CD: skip Official builds on push, add weekly schedule, publish assets #54518
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
  • Add #:item directive support #53712
    stale
  • Fix pack-publish race in ApiCompat.Task / GenAPI.Task by deduplicating the Publish build #54591
    Area-ApiCompat
  • Make ImplicitUsings/Nullable conditional on TFM in test templates #54594
    Area-Common templates
  • MSTest templates: add ExplicitProgramFile option #54596
    Area-Common templates
  • Fix `dotnet new nunit-test -n <name>` creating an unwanted `<name>/` folder #54602
  • Add per-assembly test counts to dotnet test summary (#52128) #54513
  • Disambiguate TRX filenames when running multiple test modules #54555
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #54593
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #54592
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #54381
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54584
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54574
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54506
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54505
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-Containers
  • Use `get-dotnetup` script `aka.ms` links #54606
    Area-Infrastructure
